mechanism.claim: At the fixed UTC day boundary, a large standardized residual in the completed daily Deribit DVOL change after removing its causal rolling beta on Binance BVOL identifies venue-specific options repricing. If BTC's completed daily return is nonzero, that price direction confirms the residual volatility discovery and should relay for twelve hours.
mechanism.why_distinct: CVBRPCR uses a causal cross-venue crypto-options beta residual only as a volatility-discovery selector and lets completed BTC price choose direction. CVRVPR used static DVOL/BVOL level-ratio tail crossings; RIVSCR used realized/implied levels at 8h blocks; CCBRR used Cboe VVIX/VIX changes with residual sign as direction.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: entry requires an absolute one-standard-deviation venue-specific implied-volatility repricing surprise
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily crypto-options residual confirmation clock at 00:05 UTC is absent from Gross9

features.x: daily delta log(BVOL close) at exact UTC boundary
features.y: daily delta log(DVOL close) at exact UTC boundary
features.rolling_fit: OLS y=a+b*x on at most 90 immediately prior finite daily pairs, minimum 60; current excluded
features.standardized_residual: current residual divided by sample std of prior fit residuals, positive scale
features.price_confirmation: log BTC close_D/open_D-24h over 24 consecutive completed hours, nonzero

clock.decision: exact D 00:00 UTC after volatility closes and BTC completed hours are available
clock.reservation: fixed daily decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent daily crypto-options beta-residual plus price-confirmation mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
